about.text: The Armenian yogurt drink: matsun (Armenian yogurt) thinned with water and salted, sometimes with herbs. It is drunk across the Caucasus mountains, and industrial versions have been sold since the 1990s.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Starter of lactic bacteria and dairy yeast, with water and salt added; made from cow or goat milk
